name: What is included in interior painting services?

mainEntity.name: What is included in interior painting services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our interior painting services typically include surface preparation, such as cleaning, patching, and sanding. We then apply primer and two coats of high-quality paint to walls and ceilings. Trim, doors, and windows are also painted with appropriate finishes. We protect your furniture and flooring, and ensure a thorough cleanup after the project is complete. Any specific requests for color consultations or specialized finishes can be discussed during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior painting includes surface preparation, priming, two coats of paint for walls and ceilings, trim, doors, and window painting, and cleanup.
